messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Serbian (Latin script), guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Serbian (Latin script) line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑by‑Word Mapping Table (Step 3)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase (Serbian) | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------|--------------------------------|------------------------|--------| | **mosse** | “initial moment / first hour” | **sat** | “hour” | OK | | **di** (1) | genitive linking “first hour” to “time” | **vremena** | “of time” | OK | | **prima** | “first” (temporal) | **prvi** | “first” | OK | | **quelle** | demonstrative “those” (refers to *cose*) | **i** | “and” | **WRONG** (does not render the demonstrative) | | **cose** | “beautiful things” (collective) | **doba** | “season / period” | OK | | **belle** | adjective “beautiful / sweet” | **slatko** | “sweet” | OK | | **sì** | resultative adverb “so” | **tako** | “so / thus” | OK | | **ch'** (che) | subordinating conjunction “that” | **da** | “that” | OK | | **a** (in *ch'a*) | part of the resultative clause (no separate meaning) | — (covered by **da**) | — | OK | | **bene** | adverb “good” (modifying hope) | **dobru** | “good” | OK | | **sperar** | infinitive “to hope” | **nadu** | “hope (noun)” | OK (semantic equivalent) | | **m'era** | “to me was” (experiencer + copula) | **je to bila** | “it was” (impersonal) | OK | | **cagione** | “occasion / cause” | **povod** | “occasion” | OK | | **di** (2) | preposition “concerning / of” | **u vezi** | “in regard to” | OK | | **quella** | demonstrative “that” (refers to *fiera*) | **te** | “that (genitive)” | OK | | **fiera** | “wild beast” | **divlje životinje** | “wild animal / beast” | OK | | **a** (2) | preposition “with” (instrument) | **sa** | “with” | OK | | **la** | definite article (no Serbian equivalent) | — (omitted) | — | **UNNECESSARY** (article dropped, as expected) | | **gaetta** | adjective “dappled / speckled” | **šarenom** | “dappled” | OK | | **pelle** | noun “skin” | **kožom** | “skin (instrumental)” | OK |
### Issues Detected - **WRONG:** *quelle* → rendered as **i** (“and”), which does not convey the demonstrative “those”. - **UNNECESSARY:** *la* (definite article) – correctly omitted in Serbian, which lacks articles. - No **MISSING**, **GRAMMAR**, or other **WRONG** items beyond the above.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Serbian (Latin script) script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Serbian (Latin script) text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 40** - Original: `mosse di prima quelle cose belle;` - Issue: **WRONG** – “quelle” was rendered as the conjunction “i”. - Corrected: `prvi sat vremena i to slatko doba;`
- **Line 41** - Original: `sì ch'a bene sperar m'era cagione` - Issue: **GRAMMAR** – gender agreement error (“bila” vs. masculine “povod”). - Corrected: `tako da je to bio povod za dobru nadu meni`
- **Line 42** - Original: `di quella fiera a la gaetta pelle` - Issue: **GRAMMAR** – noun number/gender mismatch (“životinje” plural). - Corrected: `u vezi te divlje životinje sa šarenom kožom`
